title: Dynamics 365 Business Central: How to record extra serial or lot number information (Item Tracking Comments)
summary: Recording extra information for serial or lot numbers using the Item Tracking Comments feature allows companies to track quality assurance details and other metadata without customization. The feature uses a dedicated table to store comments linked to each tracking number.
key_points: Create a Lot/Serial No. Information card manually or automatically from inbound documents
Add comments to tracking numbers via the Item Tracking Comments page for quality assurance and other details
No customization required, supports unlimited comments, and uses dedicated table for easy access during development
Alternative: use Notes from the system part to write notes on records

quotes.text: The advantage of this method is that it requires no customization and supports an unlimited number of comments.
quotes.why_it_matters: Highlights that this is a native capability that is easy to implement without development resources

quotes.text: It uses a dedicated table, Item Tracking Comment (6506), to manage these comments, making them relatively easy to access during custom development.
quotes.why_it_matters: Important for developers who need to access or extend this functionality programmatically
